publicationWater20.important: new state water16 + 4 visual words; does not inherit M0 publicationWater16 order

sourceSemantics.dedup64: full command32 + terminal32; append prefix in accepted state header
sourceSemantics.waterBirth: one water slot per accepted water source above eta; J+=q, W unchanged
sourceSemantics.waterIdMax: 0xffffffff assignable once; exhausted bit prevents wrap
sourceSemantics.productWire: use wire revisionWord2 and T233 T241 numeric domains; T236 mock CompletionPolicy is not authority

eventKinds.name: SOURCE_BIRTH
eventKinds.meaning: new slot mass/position/source; stock A is column PH for sand or J for water, old/new; no motion time

eventKinds.name: WATER_MOVE
eventKinds.meaning: motion J unchanged or same-column movement

eventKinds.name: CROSS
eventKinds.meaning: sand stock A/B are source/destination P; water A/B are source/destination J; sand budget used, water budget zero

eventKinds.name: CONTACT_WAIT
eventKinds.meaning: wait consumes all remaining tau; material stock unchanged unless separate LAND/ARRIVE

eventKinds.name: LAND
eventKinds.meaning: stock A=mh, B=P; material q and solid budget

eventKinds.name: BED
eventKinds.meaning: stock A=donor mh, B=receiver mh; slot/id/source zero

eventKinds.name: WATER_EDGE
eventKinds.meaning: stock A=donor W, B=receiver W; slot/id/source zero

eventKinds.name: ARRIVE
eventKinds.meaning: stock A=W, B=J; retire water slot exactly once

eventKinds.name: FINAL_CONTACT
eventKinds.meaning: bed postfold geometry, tau T to T

eventAux: nonzero only for an actual motion segment; FIELD/SOURCE/LAND/BED/WATER_EDGE/ARRIVE/FINAL_CONTACT = 0
eventUnusedWordRule: all words outside each M1 kind usedWordIndices zero; flags namespace and T16 fields only under revisionWord2
sandIdExhaustionInheritance: inherits M0 sand nextSandId U32 0 exhausted sentinel and MAX valid ID; M1 water ID exhaustion remains separately subject to its own water-ID contract and is not proven by this sand-only revision

wire.sourceReplay: completion carries original terminal including admittedUnits; receiptReplayFlag=1; stored terminal immutable replayFlag=0; no new sourceSuccess/I/commit
wire.sourceSuccess: outcome SUCCESS and root SOURCE and admittedUnits>0; kind selects I_sand or I_water; terminal SUCCESS/PARTIAL
wire.metadataReject: stock all words equal base, no source/physics commit; new-key dedup+1 or conflicting-key dedup+0
wire.fatal: diagnostic only, never accept bank or publish CURRENT
wire.revisionSeparation: M0 event kind integer values and M1 event kind integer values are distinct schemas; reader rejects wrong revision before dispatch
